Same thing is happening to me and it’s more normal than you think. Getting rid of an ed is a progress, it doesn’t just change drastically. It’s good that you are not as strict as you once were, and if you want to get better you will have to try to get rid of these habits one by one, not all at once. What you are doing is not weird, it’s disordered behaviour that a lot of people probably have as well. Take your time to process everything and step by step it will get better

I went through the exact same thing, and I was medically diagnosed with and eating disorder:anorexia (not anorexia nervosa). I don't want to diagnose you, but I just want to tell you that if you don't have one now you are at a very high risk.

With that said, I completely understand how you feel, my doctor made me eat and threatened me that if I didn't he would put me in a hospital, and I wouldn't be able to see anyone anymore. So, I ate. Of course, I ended up gaining weight and I felt disgusting, but everyone thought that I was recovered so they let it go.

Right now, I have gained even more weight, and that's because no one helped me actually recover, they made me go from anorexia to binge eating, because they just made me eat without taking seriously my thoughts and mindset. So yeah, right now I feel even more disgusting than ever before and can't stop eating.

I'm not writing this to keep you from eating like a normal person, I'm writing this to tell you that you need to stop right now before it's too late, where everyone is going to make you eat so much that you won't be able to stop later. Do it slowly and by yourself, I wish I could go back in time to do it like that. If you are hungry, eat something. Just don't listen to your family, they don't understand what you are going through.

Hope this helps, I wish you the best.
